text:
devrel-maya: Announcement: launching the Hacknight Starter Pack v0.1.0 :sparkles: — a small repo bundle with starter prompts, templates, and a deployable demo to kick off community hacknights. release: https://github.com/redwood/hacknight-starter/releases/tag/v0.1.0
devrel-maya: What you get: 3 ready-to-run mini demos (chat, embeddings, reranking), a curated prompt set, a one-page workshop agenda, and a sandbox runner for participant labs. goal: help maintainers run a 60-min hands-on session with minimal prep.
ci-bot: CI: Tag `v0.1.0` created for redwood/hacknight-starter. artifacts published; checks passed. 
security-lee: Nice! quick note: the demo seeds include mock API keys. make sure README warns people not to use real keys in examples. i'd prefer we include a short section on secrets hygiene.
devrel-maya: @security-lee good call — added a "Secrets & Safety" section to README and an environment reset script.
alex: UX nit: the runner binds to localhost:3001 by default and clashes with other local projects. can we auto-pick a free port or document how to change it?
community-rene: love this. i'll add a short tweet + community meetup listing tomorrow. also can we add a "starter challenge" slide deck for folks who want a competition track?
devrel-maya: @alex we'll add instructions to env var PORT and include an example in the quick start. @community-rene yes — adding a 2-slide challenge template in the slides folder; welcome PRs to expand it.
docs-tess: adding a tiny docs lint step that checks for TODOs in the slides and warns in CI. PR incoming.
ci-bot: Quick start snippet added to release notes:
```
# quick start for maintainers
git clone https://github.com/redwood/hacknight-starter.git
cd hacknight-starter
pnpm install
pnpm run sandbox
# open http://localhost:3001 to follow the workshop flow
```
devrel-maya: Office hours/demo tomorrow 5:00pm PT in #devrel-qa for anyone who wants to run the pack live or rehearse the agenda. bring a laptop and we'll walk through the sandbox.
security-lee: i'll hop in and show a short 5-min checklist for safe demo setups (token scoping, ephemeral accounts, log redaction).
alex: PR for auto-port fallback and README update up now: https://github.com/redwood/hacknight-starter/pull/9
community-rene: i'll schedule a volunteer maintainer cohort for next Wed 6pm PT to pilot the challenge track and gather feedback. will tag issues with `hacknight-feedback`.
devrel-maya: Huge thanks to contributors @sam-extern and @open-help for testing the runner. we'll iterate on templates based on pilot feedback. if you find anything small, please open a single-line PR labeled `chore/hacknight`. :rocket:
